head: Oncogenic RTK mutants and TKI resistance
name: Oncogenic RTK mutants and TKI resistance (KIT and PDGFR, ALK, FGFR)
rationale: All members are signaling by cancer-mutant, fused or amplified receptor tyrosine kinases and their resistance to kinase inhibitors; KIT/PDGFR, ALK and FGFR separate it from the FLT3, ERBB2 and cytokine-receptor neighbours.

head: Neutral amino acid transport
name: Neutral amino acid transport (SLC6A19, Hartnup disorder)
rationale: Plasma-membrane uptake of neutral amino acids such as tryptophan and glycine, centred on SLC6A19 and its Hartnup defects, which distinguishes it from the broader amino acid, peptide and SLC6A20/SLC36A2 transport neighbours.

head: Immune cell surface marker signatures
name: Immune cell surface marker signatures (B cells, T cells, dendritic cells)
rationale: Surface-protein signatures of leukocytes, mostly B cell with CD4 T cell and dendritic cell sets; the B cell plus T/DC mix separates it from neighbours centred on plasma cells, monocytes or antigen presentation.

head: Leloir pathway galactose catabolism
name: Leloir pathway galactose catabolism (inherited galactosemias)
rationale: Galactose breakdown via UDP-galactose and the GALK1, GALT, GALE and GALM deficiencies, distinct from the fructose, pentose and alditol neighbours.

head: Presynaptic catecholamine reuptake
name: Presynaptic catecholamine reuptake (dopamine transporter, norepinephrine transporter)
rationale: Clearance of dopamine and norepinephrine from the synapse by SLC6A3 and SLC6A2 and their disease variants, distinct from vesicular loading, catecholamine degradation and dopamine synthesis/signaling neighbours.

head: Regulation of intrinsic and extrinsic apoptosis
name: Regulation of intrinsic and extrinsic apoptosis (oxidative stress, death receptors, ligand deprivation)
rationale: Control of apoptotic signaling triggered by peroxide, oxidative stress and hypoxia or by death receptors and dependence-receptor ligand absence; the apoptosis focus and extrinsic arm separate it from oxidative-stress response and ferroptosis neighbours.

head: Cullin-RING ligase control of protein stability
name: Cullin-RING ligase control of protein stability (neddylation, RHOBTB adaptors, PD-L1 in tumor immunity)
rationale: Neddylation/deneddylation of cullin ligases and the substrate turnover they drive, with PD-L1 stability and anti-tumor T cell response as the main readout; distinct from general ubiquitination, PD-L1 transcription and proteolysis neighbours.

head: Visceral smooth muscle contraction and relaxation
name: Visceral smooth muscle contraction and relaxation (gastrointestinal motility, micturition, tachykinins)
rationale: Contractility of gut and urinary tract smooth muscle with stomach function and tachykinin input, distinct from reproductive smooth muscle, histamine and serotonin neighbours.

head: Glucagon and glucose-sensing metabolic control
name: Glucagon and glucose-sensing metabolic control (gluconeogenesis, ChREBP, triglyceride breakdown)
rationale: Hormonal (glucagon-PKA, PP2A, PDE3B) and glucose-sensing (ChREBP, carbon catabolite) control of gluconeogenesis and triglyceride use, distinct from insulin, glycogen, LXR lipogenesis and adipogenesis neighbours.

head: ERBB receptor adaptor signaling
name: ERBB receptor adaptor signaling (SHC1, GRB2)
rationale: SHC1 and GRB2 docking events downstream of EGFR, ERBB2 and ERBB4, distinct from neighbours with GRB7, PI3K, PLCG1 or ERBB3/4 dimer signaling.

head: Cardiomyocyte hypertrophic growth
name: Cardiomyocyte hypertrophic growth (cardiac muscle adaptation, sarcomere organization)
rationale: Regulation of cardiac muscle adaptation, cardiomyocyte growth and sarcomere assembly, distinct from skeletal muscle atrophy/hypertrophy, calcineurin and contractility neighbours.

head: RNA virus infection cycle
name: RNA virus infection cycle (entry, genome replication and translation, assembly)
rationale: Life-cycle stages and host interactions of coronaviruses, influenza, RSV, dengue and retroviral protein maturation, distinct from neighbours on DNA integration, reverse transcription, HCMV and latency.

head: Hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal stress axis
name: Hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal stress axis (corticotropin, glucocorticoid secretion and response)
rationale: CRH-ACTH control of cortisol/corticosterone secretion, glucocorticoid responses and stress behaviour, distinct from feeding, growth hormone, sleep and social-behaviour neuroendocrine neighbours.

head: Fc receptor signaling
name: Fc receptor signaling (mast cell activation, Fc-gamma phagocytosis, hypersensitivity)
rationale: Antibody Fc receptor signaling through FcERI in mast cells and FcGR in phagocytosis and ADCC, with hypersensitivity, distinct from B cell receptor and inhibitory-receptor neighbours.

head: Hard tissue mineralization
name: Hard tissue mineralization (bone, dentin, enamel and cementum, tooth development)
rationale: Mineralization of bone and dental tissues with odontogenesis and FGF23-Klotho/PTH inputs, distinct from phosphate-transporter and osteoclast/resorption neighbours.

head: Aromatic xenobiotic metabolism
name: Aromatic xenobiotic metabolism (CYP2E1 oxidation, N-acetylation, paracetamol)
rationale: Oxidation by CYP2E1 and N-acetylation of benzene-containing and nitrogenous compounds such as paracetamol, distinct from glycine conjugation, methylation/sulfonation and CYP1A2 neighbours.

head: Golgi glycoconjugate synthesis
name: Golgi glycoconjugate synthesis (nucleotide-sugar transporter defects, GDP-fucose, glycosphingolipids)
rationale: Supply of sugar donors to the Golgi (SLC35 transporter CDGs, SLC33A1, GDP-fucose) and Golgi glycosphingolipid synthesis, distinct from UDP-sugar, N-/O-glycan and PAPS neighbours.

head: Meiotic chromosome segregation and division
name: Meiotic chromosome segregation and division (oocyte spindle, cohesion, meiotic cell-cycle control)
rationale: Segregation and division steps of meiosis, mostly in oocytes, with cohesion and meiotic checkpoints, distinct from recombination, synapsis and male meiosis neighbours.

head: RUNX1-directed myeloid lineage specification
name: RUNX1-directed myeloid lineage specification (megakaryocytes, granulopoiesis, monocyte-macrophage restraint)
rationale: RUNX1-driven myeloid progenitor fate decisions toward megakaryocytes and granulocytes while restraining monocyte-macrophage fate, distinct from erythroid and stem cell homeostasis neighbours.

head: Axon guidance signaling
name: Axon guidance signaling (netrin-DCC, ephrin growth cone collapse, fasciculation)
rationale: Netrin-DCC attraction/repulsion and ephrin-induced growth cone collapse with RAC1 and fasciculation, distinct from SLIT-ROBO, L1 and ephrin cell-repulsion neighbours.

head: Alditol metabolism
name: Alditol metabolism (glycerol, glycerol-3-phosphate, polyol-pathway fructose synthesis)
rationale: Synthesis and breakdown of sugar alcohols including glycerol and sorbitol-to-fructose conversion, distinct from fructose catabolism disorders, pentose and acylglycerol neighbours.

head: Transepithelial water and solute transport
name: Transepithelial water and solute transport (aquaporins, paracellular magnesium, inositol)
rationale: Movement of water, magnesium, inositol and lipids across epithelial and blood-brain barriers via aquaporins, claudin paracellular routes and transporters, distinct from cation-chloride cotransporter and tight junction neighbours.

head: Second heart field cardiogenesis
name: Second heart field cardiogenesis (right ventricle formation, septal cell differentiation)
rationale: Specification and proliferation of second heart field progenitors forming the right ventricle and septum, distinct from trabeculation, heart tube and mesoderm-specification neighbours.

head: Constitutive oncogenic ERBB receptor signaling
name: Constitutive oncogenic ERBB receptor signaling (EGFR variants, ERBB2 domain mutants)
rationale: Ligand-independent signaling by EGFRvIII, cancer EGFR variants and ERBB2 domain mutants, distinct from ERBB2 drug-resistance and FGFR mutant neighbours.

head: Tubulin polyglutamylation cycle
name: Tubulin polyglutamylation cycle (microtubule severing and depolymerization)
rationale: Addition and removal of tubulin glutamate side chains and the severing/depolymerization they promote, distinct from centrosome, tubulin folding, kinesin transport and cilia neighbours.
